{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check first 10 values of revenue
print(f"Number of rows: {len(df)}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check for '999999.99' internal QA orders
count_qa = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {count_qa}")"}
